recommendations: Add a menu to the website to provide customers with food options.
Include opening hours and hours of operation to help customers plan their visits.
Implement online ordering functionality to allow customers to place orders directly on the website.
Include contact information such as phone number, email, and physical address to facilitate customer communication.
strengths: The website has a responsive design and mobile usability.
It has a good SEO setup with a title, meta description, and structured data.
Social media presence is strong with multiple platforms integrated.
